title: AtomWorld-Mirror: Macro-Step World Modeling of Critical Evolution Backbones for Materials Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.11527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Atomistic simulation is a fundamental tool for studying long-term materials evolution, from diffusion and defect dynamics to interfacial reactions and fracture. Yet conventional simulators typically advance at microscopic resolution, spending substantial computation on low-impact local updates before reaching structurally consequential states, an evolutionary-resolution bottleneck that limits long-horizon simulation. We propose AtomWorld-Mirror, a time-aware macro-step world model for the critical evolution backbone of atomic systems. For Step-Wise atomistic simulation, AtomWorld-Mirror distills short micro-event segments into physically reachable transitions between key states, jointly predicting sparse structural edits and accumulated physical time through latent macro-step dynamics. translated_title: AtomWorld-Mirror：面向材料动力学关键演化骨架的宏步世界建模
translated_abstract: 原子模拟是研究材料长期演化的基础工具，涵盖扩散、缺陷动力学、界面反应和断裂等过程。然而，传统模拟器通常以微观分辨率逐步推进，在到达结构上具有关键意义的态之前，需要在低影响的局部更新上耗费大量计算，这种“演化分辨率瓶颈”限制了长时间尺度的模拟。我们提出AtomWorld-Mirror，一个面向原子系统关键演化骨架的时间感知宏步世界模型。对于逐步式的原子模拟，AtomWorld-Mirror将短暂的微观事件片段蒸馏为关键态之间物理可达的跃迁，通过潜在的宏步动力学联合预测稀疏的结构编辑和累积的物理时间。每个跃迁都受到局部可达性、组分守恒和连续时间一致性的约束。通过将局部原子物理摊销为可复用的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出时间感知的宏步世界模型AtomWorld-Mirror，通过将微观事件片段蒸馏为关键态之间物理可达的跃迁，联合预测稀疏结构编辑与累积物理时间，突破传统原子模拟的演化分辨率瓶颈，实现材料长期动力学的高效建模。
en_tdlr: AtomWorld-Mirror is a time-aware macro-step world model that distills micro-event segments into physically reachable transitions between key states, jointly predicting sparse structural edits and accumulated physical time to overcome the evolutionary-resolution bottleneck of conventional atomistic simulators for long-horizon materials dynamics.
